## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 本季度收入同比增长百分比及计算过程

**原文出处**：`press_release.txt` 第 3115 行；`financial_statements.txt` 第 8877 行；`transcript.txt` 第 24808 行。

| 项目 | FY26 Q4 (Three Months Ended June 30, 2026) | FY25 Q4 (Three Months Ended June 30, 2025) |
|---|---|---|
| Intelligent Cloud 收入 | **$39,306 百万** | **$29,878 百万** |

**计算过程**：

$$\text{Y/Y 增长率} = \frac{39{,}306 - 29{,}878}{29{,}878} \times 100 = \frac{9{,}428}{29{,}878} \times 100 \approx 31.6\%$$

管理层在新闻稿中将此数字四舍五入为 **32%**（按报告口径），按固定汇率调整为 **31%**（`press_release.txt` 位置 3115；`transcript.txt` 位置 24808）。

---

### 2. 管理层在电话会上归因的因素（逐条引用原话）

**出处**：`transcript.txt` 第 24808–24890 行（Amy Hood 在电话会上的分段陈述）。

管理层将 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 收入增长 32% 归因于以下因素：

> **归因 A — Azure 强劲增长（43%）**
> *"In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity."*
> 
> **归因 B — CPU/GPU 效率提升释放产能**
> *"Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity."*
> 
> **归因 C — 新增产能被快速变现**
> *"That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."*
> 
> **归因 D — GitHub Copilot 消费超预期**
> *"Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."*
> 
> **归因 E — 本地服务器业务合同续约的计时影响**
> *"In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."*
> 
> **归因 F — 共同 R&D 投资带来的运营杠杆**（间接影响利润率，但支撑收入增长环境）
> *"Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier."*

---

### 3. 事实 vs 前瞻性表述——逐条标注

| 归因 | 事实/前瞻 | 判断依据 |
|---|---|---|
| **A. Azure 增长 43%，需求超过可用产能** | **已发生的事实** | "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" 描述当前季度正在发生的状况。数据 "Azure and other cloud services revenue increased 43%" 来自已发布的财报 `press_release.txt` 第 3115 行。 |
| **B. CPU/GPU 效率提升使增长超预期** | **已发生的事实** | "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet" — "was ahead of expectations" 是对 FY26 Q4 已发生结果的回顾性描述。 |
| **C. 新增产能被快速变现** | **已发生的事实** | "That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized" — "in-quarter" 和 "was" 明确指本季度已发生的变现结果。 |
| **D. GitHub Copilot 消费超预期** | **已发生的事实** | "Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption" — "stronger-than-expected" 是对本季度实际结果的回顾性评价，"benefited" 为过去时态。 |
| **E. 本地服务器续约的计时影响** | **已发生的事实** | "results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition" — "in-period" 指出这是本季度已确认的计时点效应。 |
| **F. 共同 R&D 投资** | **已发生的事实** | "Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier" — 直接引用 FY26 Q4 已发生的费用增长数据。 |

**前瞻性表述（管理层未在本次电话会归因中直接出现，但出现在后续展望部分）**：

> *"In Azure, we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency and we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply. Even with the strong close to Q4, we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate."*
> 
> （出处：`transcript.txt` 第 32535 行 — **FY27 Q1 展望部分**）

这一表述是前瞻性的，因为它：
- 使用了 "we expect"（预期）
- 使用了 "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate"（对未来半年的预期）
- 引用的是 FY27 Q1 的预测数据（$40.95–$41.25B，增长 33%–34%），而非已公布的 FY26 Q4 结果

---

### 总结

- FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 收入为 **$393.06 亿**，同比增长 **~32%**（报告口径），较 FY25 Q4 的 **$298.78 亿** 增加了约 **$94.28 亿**。
- 管理层归因全部为**已发生事实**——包括 Azure 43% 增长、CPU/GPU 效率释放产能、GitHub Copilot 超预期消费、续约计时效应以及共同 R&D 投资。
- 电话会中**没有**将任何前瞻性表述作为对 Q4 增长的归因。前瞻性内容仅出现在随后的 FY27 Q1 展望中（Azure 预期 45% 增长、H1 加速等）。
